clearedSpotChecks.check: uint256 master 908714a0: does its change reach a value the PoolManager computes? The PoolManager's only route to MODEXP (0x05) is a take naming it as recipient or currency (P1, P2).
clearedSpotChecks.note: proxy.golang.org master.info returns v1.3.3-0.20261127205719-908714a05a47 (2026-11-27T20:57:19Z). erigon main go.mod line 66 pins 808a9d02b85f and geth master go.mod line 43 pins v1.3.2, so no client runs the new commit. EIP-7823 (Final) caps each MODEXP length at 1024 bytes and fails the call above it. On https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com (reth/v2.11.0-b9abbcc) eth_call to 0x05 with the 68 byte transfer calldata that src/types/Currency.sol:59-73 builds returns 'out of gas: gas exhausted during precompiled contract execution', so Currency.transfer reverts at src/types/Currency.sol:81-84 and take (src/PoolManager.sol:291-297) reverts. eth_call to 0x05 with value 1 and empty data (the native branch, src/types/Currency.sol:45-49) returns 0x with success, which only spends the caller's own negative delta. Neither path moves another user's funds.

clearedSpotChecks.check: L-1317: the 20 reentry scenarios of cycle 36 sent through the pocket gateway, which rotates over erigon 3.8.1 and 3.8.2 builds that carry the frame cache.
clearedSpotChecks.note: rpcshapes-pocket-rounds.json records n 20, rounds 6, agree 120, differ 0, noAnswer 0 and the PoolManager code hash a7aaa3ba equal to pmdiff-eth.json. Eight web3_clientVersion calls I sent to https://eth.api.pocket.network returned erigon/3.8.1-cf6f1413 twice, reth v2.10.1 twice and reth v2.11.0 four times, so the gateway does rotate onto erigon 3.8.1. The caveat in the item holds: the rotation samples are separate requests, so no scenario is tied to an erigon backend, and eth_call exercises the frame cache on a single message, not under block execution. The clearance is right as a statistical result and should not be read as a per-scenario one. The open lead stays low priority.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Upcoming forks within six months, assumed shipped: native settle credits msg.value only (src/PoolManager.sol:352-354), so ETH credited outside a call is booked to no one.
clearedSpotChecks.note: src/PoolManager.sol:348-364 reads the synced currency; when it is address(0) paid is msg.value, otherwise a nonzero msg.value reverts (NonzeroNativeValue) and paid is the ERC20 balance difference against the synced reserves, after which the currency is reset. A balance change of the PoolManager that does not arrive as msg.value of the settle call is not credited to any caller, so a fork that credits ETH without a call cannot be turned into a delta. src/types/Currency.sol:48 and :73 and src/libraries/Hooks.sol:134 pass gas() without branching on its value.
